# Apache ECharts (vendored)

- Version: 6.1.0
- Project: Apache ECharts
- Homepage: https://echarts.apache.org/
- Upstream package: `echarts@6.1.0`
- Vendored file: `echarts.min.js`
- License: Apache License 2.0

The JavaScript file is the upstream browser distribution `dist/echarts.min.js`.
It is stored locally in the child theme so the About/Impact Elementor widget has no runtime CDN dependency.

The complete upstream `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` files are included in this directory.
